error_message: Database connection pool timeout limit exceeded (10000ms)
description: Payment checkout failing for 15% of active users with DB connection timeout errors during peak checkout traffic.
root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion under high concurrency (max_connections=20 hit)
resolution: Increased database connection pool size from 20 to 50 in pool_config.yaml

description: Recurring DB-504 connection timeout issue under flash sale traffic surge.
root_cause: Insufficient DB pool allocation for surge traffic
resolution: Added read replica and connection pool tuning (pool_size=50, max_overflow=20)

error_message: JWT signing key rotation mismatch across instances
description: Users unable to log in following hotfix release. Token validation fails across microservices.
root_cause: Asynchronous key rotation deployment left 2 instances validating against deprecated public key
resolution: Flushed Redis token cache and synchronized JWT public key config across all auth pods

description: Order creation crashing immediately upon deployment of v2.4.0.
root_cause: Helm chart template omitted INVENTORY_SERVICE_URL configmap entry
resolution: Updated Kubernetes ConfigMap with INVENTORY_SERVICE_URL and triggered rolling restart

error_message: Elasticsearch cluster master node election timeout
description: Search auto-complete latency spiked to 8000ms with intermittent 504 errors.
root_cause: JVM Heap garbage collection pause exceeded 30s on master node 2
resolution: Increased Elasticsearch JVM heap allocation from 4GB to 8GB and enabled G1GC

error_message: SendGrid API rate limit exceeded (429 Too Many Requests)
description: Email notifications failing during bulk marketing campaign broadcast.
root_cause: Marketing email job ran on main transactional email queue without rate limiter throttling
resolution: Isolated transactional and bulk email queues with distinct API keys and leaky bucket rate limiter

error_message: Stripe webhook HMAC signature verification failure
description: Payment status callbacks failing to update invoice status in database.
root_cause: Stripe secret key updated in dashboard without updating webhook listener secret
resolution: Rotated STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in Kubernetes secrets and restarted listener service

error_message: Node.js JavaScript heap out of memory crash
description: Profile service pod crashlooping every 45 minutes under heavy load.
root_cause: Unbounded user avatar image buffering in memory before upload to S3 bucket
resolution: Refactored image file upload pipeline to use AWS S3 multipart streaming transform streams

error_message: gRPC channel thread pool deadlock under load
description: Stock reservation calls hanging indefinitely until request timeout.
root_cause: Synchronous blocking call inside gRPC event looper executor thread
resolution: Offloaded database IO operations to dedicated background thread executor pool

error_message: CoreDNS resolution timeout for internal cluster endpoints
description: Gateway failing to resolve backend service microservice domain names.
root_cause: CoreDNS deployment replica count (2) insufficient for cluster DNS query volume
resolution: Scaled CoreDNS deployment from 2 to 5 replicas and enabled local DNS caching node-local-dns
